name: Curse of the Farlands
description:
• When applied to a tool, breaking a block instead breaks a random adjacent block.

  • When applied to boots, your position periodically rounds.

  • [term:curse][red]Curse Spell[/red][/term]: [dark-red]Sacrifice 2.5❤️[/dark-red] to stretch spacetime in the target cardinal direction for 30 seconds, during which punches and curses cast in that direction have infinite range.
